items.stem: A browser shows a certificate warning for an internal site using a self-signed certificate. Why?

options.text: The certificate is not signed by a CA the browser already trusts
options.rationale: Correct: trust requires a chain to a recognised authority.
They can encrypt; the issue is trust, not encryption.
A warning does not mean the site is offline.
A certificate warning is distinct from DNS failure.

items.explanation: Correct: a self-signed certificate is not chained to a trusted authority, so the browser warns.
